svg.font-family: pw-sans-1wb8d5ek9gi, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Checkout
svg.desc: Checkout: 5 nodes, 4 connections. Nodes: - Web tier, service, drawn in full in part 2 - Orders API, service - Payments, service - Orders, database - Events, queue Connections: - Web tier to Orders API: places order - Orders API to Payments: charges - Orders API to Orders: writes - Orders API to Events: publishes
svg.metadata:
flow "Checkout" direction=right
node web service "Web tier" part=2 node api service "Orders API" node pay service "Payments" icon=lucide:credit-card node db database "Orders" node queue queue "Events"
web -> api : "places order" api -> pay : "charges" api -> db : "writes" api -> queue : "publishes"
